name: Doylestown YMCA Summer Camp
description_short: Weekly YMCA day camp at the Doylestown YMCA with grade based Adventure Camp groups, sports and specialty weeks, esports, a teen travel camp and daily indoor swimming; full day, half day and three day options.
special_needs_notes: Ability Camp serves campers from kindergarten to age 21 who need smaller ratios.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim indoors every day at the Doylestown YMCA; private lessons can be added.
notes: Summer 2027 runs June 14 to August 26, 2027; Teen Travel Camp (grades 6 to 8) June 22 to August 7. The 2027 weekly theme list starts June 7, a week before the stated season start. Full day 9 am to 4 pm, half day 9 am to noon or 12:30 to 3:30 pm, extended care 7 to 9 am and 4 to 6 pm. Groups: Jr. Adventure ages 3 to 4, Otters rising kindergartners, Adventure Camp grades 1 to 7, CIT rising grades 8 to 10. Lunch can be ordered from BCON in the lobby as an add on; Pizza Fridays. A 2027 summer membership (youth $135) gives member camp pricing. Camp Concierge enrollment help for a one time $50 fee. Praesidium accredited. Weekly 2027 prices not posted yet.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Doylestown camp page: 2027 season, ages 3 through entering 10th grade (age 21 for Ability Camp), hours, extended care, financial assistance, program list and 2027 weekly themes. Age max 16 is derived from entering grade 10 (grade plus 6).
